text:
```yaml
name: Assign label to bot PRs

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types:
      - opened
      - reopened

permissions:
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  assign-label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: |
      github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'dependabot[bot]' ||
      github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'transifex-integration[bot]' ||
      github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'imgbot[bot]'
    steps:
      - name: Assign label
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            github.rest.issues.addLabels({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              labels: [':heavy_check_mark: dependencies']
            })
```
